name: mehmetmutlu
description: Claude Code plugins by Mehmet Mutlu: skills and mods I use every day, cleaned up so they work on anyone's machine

plugins.name: project-workflow
plugins.description: Start a project the same way every time (create-project) and save what a session decided before you close it (save-context).

plugins.name: subtask-icons
plugins.description: Small ⑂ icons under Claude's last answer, one per item; a press puts /subtask with that item's text in the prompt box

plugins.name: context-alarm
plugins.description: Warns when the context window passes a threshold (80% by default) and suggests /save-context before compaction

plugins.name: answer-buttons
plugins.description: Three small buttons under Claude's last answer: Plain English, Shorter, and Plain & short

plugins.name: skill-stats
plugins.description: Counts how often each skill runs, lists the ones that never trigger, and hands a weak description to skill-creator

plugins.name: dash-guard
plugins.description: Refuses prose that Claude writes with an em dash, an en dash or a double hyphen, and tells Claude which lines to rewrite

plugins.name: shared-file-guard
plugins.description: Refuses a shell write to a shared file (STATUS.md, CLAUDE.md, MEMORY.md, or the files you name) that this session has not read, or that another session changed since

plugins.name: dragon-lair
plugins.description: A small pixel dragon above the prompt that acts out what Claude is doing and breathes fire at the moments worth celebrating: a commit, a merge, a finished task list, a PDF made.

plugins.name: jackpot
plugins.description: A pixel slot machine above the prompt: every finished turn pulls the lever, and the moments worth celebrating (a commit, a skill run, a deploy, a finished task list) earn golden spins.

plugins.name: outlaw
plugins.description: An Atari Outlaw duel above the prompt: your gunslinger fires at the moments worth celebrating, the bug fires when a tool fails, and the cactus between them gets shot to pieces.

plugins.name: tama
plugins.description: A classic Tamagotchi above the prompt: it gets hungry, bored and messy in real time, finished turns feed it, the moments worth celebrating cheer it up, and failed tools leave a mess.

plugins.name: tetris
plugins.description: A classic Tetris in a small handheld screen above the prompt, played by Claude's work: every tool drops a piece, failed tools push up garbage, and the moments worth celebrating clear rows.

plugins.name: octo-invader
plugins.description: A pixel octopus invades a city the full width of the line above the prompt: it smashes buildings while Claude edits and pulls planes out of the sky at the moments worth celebrating.

plugins.name: arcade
plugins.description: The Claude Code Arcade in one install: dragon-lair, jackpot, outlaw, tama and tetris, five games above the prompt that your work plays.

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: The Claude Code Toolkit in one install: subtask-icons, context-alarm, answer-buttons, skill-stats, dash-guard and shared-file-guard.
